product_brief: Rust PKCS#11 engine serving as WASM crypto path for in-browser HSM and production backend for KMIP server.
pqc_capability_description: Implements ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and stateful HSS/LMS. Uses patched FIPS reference crates (fips204-patched, fips205-patched, hbs-lms-patched). Includes ACVP feature for conformance KATs and carries checked-in conformance evidence.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, HSS, LMS, AES, HMAC, RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA, SP800-108 KBKDF
key_management_model: PKCS#11 v3.2 surface implementation; acts as backend for KMIP server and CACP policy engine.
architecture_type: Software library (Rust), WASM bundle, Native library
fips_validated: Not stated (Uses "FIPS reference crates" with local patches; mentions FIPS 204/205/206 context via algorithm names, but no validation status is explicitly claimed for the engine itself)
signature_schemes: ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, HSS, LMS, ECDSA, EdDSA, RSA
testing_&_validation_methods: PKCS#11 v3.2 conformance (188 checks), KAT parity vs C++ engine, ACVP conformance KATs, unit/integration tests, R3.6 parameter-set coverage
